cohort: 234 patients with singleton term gestations who underwent cesarean section for fetal distress diagnosed on the basis of abnormal cardiotocography at Lady Reading Hospital Peshawar from June 2015 to June 2016.
finding: Fetal distress diagnosed on CTG alone poorly correlates with fetal outcome, with 70.94% of cesarean sections resulting in a good fetal outcome (Apgar score ≥ 7).
